name: Korean Dip
steps: Start in straight-arm support on a fixed horizontal bar, gripping overhand just wider than your shoulders with the bar behind your hips.
Brace your trunk and let your legs extend slightly forward for balance.
Bend your elbows and lower your hips in front of the bar through a comfortable shoulder range.
Press down into the bar and straighten your arms to regain support.
tips: Descend only as deep as your shoulder mobility allows comfortably without pinching.
Control the entire movement rather than swinging your legs wildly to rebound out of the bottom.
